For fun, for the plot, for you.

No powers required

Let the memes speak.

  1. Think of a question. About love, life, or bakit ka ganyan.
  2. Tap Draw a card. The meme is your message—interpret it however you like.
  3. Draw again, shuffle the remaining deck, or clear your card.

Every card appears once per round. When you’ve seen the whole deck, a fresh round starts automatically. Your progress stays in this browser when you refresh.

Just for entertainment, mhie. You’re still in charge of your life.
